definitions.case_measure: Sum of Number of Cases under CONFIRMED, PROBABLE and SUSPECT_OR_COMPATIBLE classification groups for valid onset/count rows, selected 2018–2025 territories. Reported non-discarded retrospective surveillance cases; not unique patients, population incidence or confirmed-only cases.
definitions.signal_grain: 2,171 = 1,787 DOH territory/disease/month records + 384 PAGASA territory/month records. Weather has 383 complete rainfall totals. Distinct month counts must retain provider/territory/disease scope, rather than treating mixed signal rows as a single continuous monthly series.
definitions.missingness: No source observation is not a verified zero. January–September 2026 DOH is partial. PAGASA 2025 is absent; NASA is a separate proxy.
definitions.units: PAGASA wind is m/s at source and converted to kph in Silver. Old TMEAN is reported, newer batch mean is derived TMAX/TMIN midpoint. -999 becomes null; -1 rainfall is a disclosed lower-bound zero.
